voiceJobs.promptText: I've never seen snow from dry land before!
I've wound Grandmother's thread back on its spool. Every inch of it.
The last time I was this cold, somebody threw me a rope.
The last time I was this cold, I crossed a ladder to get home.
And Wick will need it to find his way back!
A bit of elbow grease, and... there!
Go and find him, Pip. I'll keep the light till you're back.
Then I'll be the keeper for a bit. I know what this light means to someone lost.
Welcome home, keepers. I kept her shining, every minute.
